name: 收入会计核算 (5VW)
description_en_html:
Overview

The scope item enables you to manage revenue recognition according to IFRS 15 and ASC 606 following the five-step model.

Revenue contracts are created automatically for the corresponding operational orders.

You can identify the performance obligations included in each revenue contract based on the items in the operational order.

You can determine the total price and then allocating the total price among the performance obligations based on the standalone selling price.

The revenue for performance obligations is recognized as they’re fulfilled over time.

You calculate contract liability and contract asset values and make postings to the general ledger to reflect revenue-related recognition transactions.

Key Process Flow

  • Manage revenue contracts
  • Process revenue contracts
  • Perform periodic activities including transfer revenue, calculate contract liabilities and contract assets, and post revenue to the general ledger
  • Shift revenue contracts to next period

Business Benefits

  • Eliminate the need for manual processes through process automation and integration
  • Support compliance to revenue accounting standard IFRS 15 and ASC 606
  • Provide reconcilable contract management for revenue recognition
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目使您能够按照五步模型根据 IFRS 15 和 ASC 606 管理收入确认。

将自动为相应的运营订单创建收入合同。

您可以根据运营订单中的项目，识别每个收入合同中包含的履约义务。

您可以确定总价，然后根据单独售价在履约义务之间分配总价。

履约义务的收入随着时间的推移而确认。

计算合同负债和合同资产值，并过账到总账以反映与收入相关的确认交易。

关键流程流

  • 管理收入合同
  • 处理收入合同
  • 执行定期活动，包括传输收入、计算合同负债和合同资产，并将收入过账到总账
  • 将收入合同转移到下一期间

业务优势

  • 通过流程自动化和集成，消除手动流程的需求
  • 支持收入会计标准 IFRS 15 和 ASC 606 的合规性
  • 为收入确认提供可对账的合同管理
